## Brand Strategy
- No explicit brand strategy section. The guide is purely a visual and production style guide -- operational rather than strategic.
- Implicitly positions ICFF as North America's platform for global design, anchored at the Javits Center, NYC.

## Logo
- **Form**: Custom-drawn wordmark "ICFF" inside a bounding box. Never to be recreated by typesetting.
- **Clear space**: X = 1/4 of logo height, maintained on all sides.
- **Minimum size**: 0.75 inches.
- **Proportion/placement**: Medium applications (letterhead, ads, desktop): 1/6 to 1/8 of application width, bottom-left corner preferred. Small applications (business cards, badges, mobile): 1/2 to 1/4 of application width.
- **Partnerships**: Lock-up with "+" or "x" signifier; partner logo scaled to ICFF text block height; 3X spacing.
- **Misuse rules**: No recreation, no removing parts, no proportion/bounding-box changes, no stretching/shearing, no rotation, no drop shadows, no colour alterations, no bounding-box removal, no knocked-out text on images.

## Typography
- **Display headline**: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Demi -- with hairline strokes above and below each line. Offset determined by width of lowercase "a" stem.
- **Body header**: Memphis Bold (all caps, 8.5/11 pt, tracking 20).
- **Body copy**: Memphis Light (9.5/11 pt, tracking 5).
- **Extra small information**: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Book (6/7.5 pt).
- **Hairline rules**: Extremely precise specifications -- 1pt for 50-200pt type sizes, .75/.5pt below 50pt, never below .25pt.
- **Best practices**: Left-aligned headlines, proper kerning (especially numeral "1"), use hyphens not en-dashes for number ranges, title-case for short headlines, hairline between every line break.

## Colour
- **Palette**: Strictly black and white.
  - Black: RGB 0 0 0 / CMYK 0 0 0 100% / `#000000`
  - White: RGB 255 255 255 / `#FFFFFF`
  - Rich Black: CMYK 30 30 30 100%
- **Paint specification**: Benjamin Moore Black (2132-10) Eggshell.
- **Usage**: Primary = black background + white type. Information-heavy layouts may invert to black on white.
- **Logo assets**: Separate files provided for RGB, CMYK 100% Black, and CMYK Rich Black -- both white-on-black and black-on-white versions.

## Graphics / Patterns
- No graphic system or pattern library. The visual language relies entirely on typography (hairline rules) and the monochrome palette.
- Hairline strokes flanking headlines serve as the primary graphic device.

## Photography
- No photography guidelines included. The guide is entirely typographic and environmental/signage-focused.

## Applications
- Extensive and production-ready:
  - **Print layouts**: Feature (black background, large headlines), informational (white background, dense copy).
  - **Website**: Assumed but details not fully captured in text extraction.
  - **On-site signage**: Concourse entrance banners (30' x 12'), escalator banners, connector banners, floor signage (printed honeycomb board on steel plate stands), theater vinyl wall graphics, newsstand signage, exhibitor table signs.
  - **Specifications**: Material call-outs (18oz matte vinyl, 1/2" Gilman honeycomb board, blackened steel plate), exact dimensions, pocket details.
  - **Cafe/menu**: Pricing layouts included.

## Tone of Voice
- Not addressed in this document.

## Outliers / Notable Features
- Designed by 2x4, a notable New York design consultancy.
- Unusually deep typographic system -- the hairline-rule mechanic is mathematically derived from the letterform itself (stem width of lowercase "a"), which is rare and craft-intensive.
- Strictly monochrome identity (black and white only) -- no accent colours whatsoever.
- Extremely production-oriented: includes physical material specs, substrate details, and fabrication notes for trade-show environments.
- No photography, no graphic system, no tone of voice -- purely a visual/production manual.

## Quality Score
**4 / 5** -- Exceptionally thorough on typography and production specifications. The hairline system is best-in-class for typographic rigour. Loses a point for complete absence of brand strategy, tone of voice, and photography guidance -- though this is appropriate for a trade-show style guide focused on environmental execution.
